answer: Quadratic voting prices influence in locked stake, not key count: the nth vote costs n squared, so one sparrow with a single stake casts one cheap vote, while a gale of a thousand fakes must pay the quadratic sum — a dune of cost that grows faster than the votes it buys. Splitting one budget across fakes never beats concentrating it, so cloning keys buys no extra power, and honest agents keep their voice.
